items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 25 November 2026 4:20pm
items.description:
##Today##

Staying dry this evening and tonight, with variable cloud and moderate or fresh southeast winds. Minimum temperature tonight around 3 or 4°C. Comments: Nil.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 3°C and max. air temperature 8°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0

15


##Wind Direction##

SE


##Wind##

##Visibility##

Good.


##Comments##

##Tomorrow##

Dry for much of the day tomorrow, then rain will arrive in the evening. The southeast winds will increase, becoming fresh to strong by about lunchtime, then possibly touch gale force around the northern and southern tips of the island by the end of the day. Maximum temperature 8°C. Comments: Strong winds. Risk of gales in exposed areas later. Snowdonia providing some shelter, limiting the extent of gale force winds.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 3°C and max. air temperature 8°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-5


##Wind Speed##

25


##Wind Direction##

SE


##Wind##

Southeast 15-20, becoming 20-30 by lunchtime, possibly touching 35-45 around the northern and southern tips of the island later in evening.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain later. Hill fog later.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Friday, 27 November 2026##

Rain at first on Friday, heavy at times, but clearing during the morning, leaving the rest of the day generally dry with sunny/ clear intervals. The strong to gale force southeast winds will ease as the rain clears. Max temperature 9°C. Comments: Strong to gale force winds and heavy rain at first. Risk of coastal overtopping (at ~00:35 hours).
